def paint(n: int, ops: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
    m = len(ops)
    size = 1
    while size < m:
        size <<= 1

    max_colour = [0] * (2 * size)
    has_erase = bytearray(2 * size)

    events = []
    for i, op in enumerate(ops):
        events.append((op[1], i + 1))
        events.append((op[2] + 1, -(i + 1)))
    events.sort()

    counts = {}
    previous = events[0][0]
    j = 0

    while j < len(events):
        position = events[j][0]
        colour = max_colour[1]
        if colour:
            counts[colour] = counts.get(colour, 0) + position - previous

        while j < len(events) and events[j][0] == position:
            event = events[j][1]
            index = abs(event) - 1
            node = size + index

            if event > 0:
                op = ops[index]
                if op[0] == 1:
                    max_colour[node] = op[3]
                    has_erase[node] = 0
                else:
                    max_colour[node] = 0
                    has_erase[node] = 1
            else:
                max_colour[node] = 0
                has_erase[node] = 0

            node >>= 1
            while node:
                left = node << 1
                right = left | 1

                has_erase[node] = has_erase[left] | has_erase[right]
                if has_erase[right]:
                    max_colour[node] = max_colour[right]
                else:
                    left_colour = max_colour[left]
                    right_colour = max_colour[right]
                    max_colour[node] = (
                        left_colour if left_colour > right_colour else right_colour
                    )
                node >>= 1

            j += 1

        previous = position

    return [[colour, counts[colour]] for colour in sorted(counts)]
